Name: Prep
rules_text: Gain 1 Time.

Name: Practice Session
rules_text: Gain 2 Time.

Name: Masterclass
rules_text: Gain 3 Time.

Name: Cheese Board
rules_text: During judging if you present another Cheese dish gain +2 Favor and 1 Time.

Name: Raclette
rules_text: Other Cheese dishes you present get +1 Taste.

Name: Foie Gras Toast
rules_text: If this is your only Appetizer it gets +2 Taste.

Name: Bouillabaisse
rules_text: During judging if this is your only Main it gets +2 Taste.

Name: Escargots
rules_text: If the Judge does not favor you this gets +2 Taste.

Name: Saucisson
rules_text: You may attach this to another Dish. If you do, gain 1 Time.

Name: Burger
rules_text: During judging if you present an Extra this gets +1 Taste.

Name: Hot Dog
rules_text: During judging if you present another Main this gets +2 Taste. If that Main is Meat, gain 1 Time.

Name: Fried Chicken
rules_text: During judging if you present another Fried dish this gets +2 Taste.

Name: Freedom Fries
rules_text: During judging if you present a Meat dish this gets +2 Taste and you gain 1 Time.

Name: Deep-Fried Pickles
rules_text: During judging if you present another Fried dish this gets +2 Taste and each opponent gains Food Coma.

Name: Sloppy Joe
rules_text: During judging if you present another Tomato dish gain +1 Favor.

Name: Sushi Set
rules_text: During judging if you present Appetizer Main and Dessert gain +2 Favor.

Name: Onigiri
rules_text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Discard up to 1 of them. If it is a Status, Peel it instead.

Name: Tempura
rules_text: During judging if you present no duplicate core course this gets +1 Taste.

Name: Katsu Curry Rice
rules_text: If you Peeled this turn this gets +1 Taste.

Name: Sashimi
rules_text: Draw 2 then discard 1. If you discard a Status, gain 1 Time.

Name: Takoyaki
rules_text: If this is your only Extra you may Peel 1. Then look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

Name: Margherita Pizza
rules_text: During judging if you present another Cheese or Tomato dish this gets +1 Taste.

Name: Spaghetti Bolognese
rules_text: If the Judge does not favor you this gets +2 Taste.

Name: Caprese
rules_text: During judging if you present a Main gain +1 Favor.

Name: Risotto
rules_text: During judging if you present another Rice or Cheese dish gain +1 Favor.

Name: Tiramisu
rules_text: If the Judge does not favor you gain +2 Favor.

Name: Arancini
rules_text: During judging if you present another Rice dish gain +1 Favor.

Name: Ghost Pepper Wings
rules_text: When you present this, Scorch 3.

Name: Wasabi Challenge
rules_text: When you present this, Scorch 2. If you Scorched a Status this way, gain 1 Favor.

Name: Side Salad
rules_text: When you present this, choose which course it counts as.

Name: Tasting Menu
rules_text: When you present this, choose which course it counts as. If it completes all 3 core courses, gain 1 Time.

Name: Knife Skills
rules_text: Upgrade a starter card by up to 2.

Name: Clean Station
rules_text: Peel up to 2 starter cards. If you peeled no cards this way, Peel Clean Station.

Name: Taste Test
rules_text: Draw 3 then discard 1. You may Peel a starter or Status from your discard pile.

Name: Heckle
rules_text: Each opponent gains a Distraction. If there is only one opponent, they gain 2 Distractions instead.

Name: Perfect
rules_text: Choose a Dish. Double its Taste this turn.

Name: Mock
rules_text: Choose an opponent's highest-Taste presented dish. It gets -2 Taste this turn. Draw 1.

Name: Drown in Butter
rules_text: Choose an opponent's presented dish. If it is not French it gets -3 Taste this turn and its owner gains Food Coma.

Name: Mine Is Better
rules_text: Reveal a Dish from your hand. If it has more Taste than an opponent's presented dish that dish gets -3 Taste this turn.

Name: Bon Appetit!
rules_text: Draw 1. During judging if one of your dishes has 5 or more Taste gain +2 Favor.

Name: Supersize Me!
rules_text: During judging copy one of your dishes as an additional presented dish.

Name: More Meat!
rules_text: Your Meat dishes get +1 Taste this turn. During judging if you present at least 2 Meat dishes gain +2 Favor.

Name: Deep Fry
rules_text: Choose a Dish. It becomes Fried this turn and gets +2 Taste.

Name: Party
rules_text: Draw 1 and gain 1 Time. During judging if you present at least 3 dishes gain +2 Favor.

Name: Ketchup Me That
rules_text: Choose a Meat or Fried dish. It gets +2 Taste.

Name: Appropriate
rules_text: Choose an opponent's presented dish. After that opponent scores, steal that dish and add it to your discard pile. Peel Appropriate.

Name: Purify
rules_text: Peel up to 2 cards. If you Peel a Status this way, draw 1.

Name: Order
rules_text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put 2 into your hand and the rest back in any order.

Name: Omakase
rules_text: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Dish. Present it. If it completes all 3 core courses gain +2 Favor.

Name: Less Is More
rules_text: During judging if you present exactly Appetizer Main and Dessert with no duplicate core course gain +5 Favor.

Name: Wasabi Attack
rules_text: Choose an opponent's dish. It gets -1 Taste. If it is not Seafood it gets -3 Taste instead. Its owner Peels the top card of their deck.

Name: Mangia, Mangia!
rules_text: Draw 1. If the Judge does not favor you, draw 2 and gain 1 Time instead.

Name: Mamma Mia!
rules_text: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Dish. Put it into your hand, then draw 1. If the Judge does not favor you, you may present that Dish this turn.

Name: Secondo
rules_text: During judging score one Main a second time.

Name: Breaking Spaghetti Is A Crime
rules_text: Each opponent who modified a dish this turn gains Shame. Choose one modified dish; it gets -2 Taste.

Name: More Olive Oil!
rules_text: Choose a Tomato or Cheese dish. It gets +2 Taste. If the Judge does not favor you, it gets +3 Taste instead.

Name: More Parmigiano!
rules_text: Choose a Main. It gets +2 Taste. If it is Cheese or Tomato it gets +3 Taste instead.

Name: Market Research Focus Group
rules_text: Rotate up to 3 cards in the market. Draw 1. Gain 1 Time.

Name: Yelp Bomb
rules_text: Choose an opponent. They gain a Yelp Review. Draw 1.

Name: Health Inspector Raid
rules_text: Each opponent gains a Health Inspection. Rotate the whole market.

Name: We're Gonna Build A Wall
rules_text: Each opponent gains a Health Inspection. Until your next turn, opponents cannot steal your dishes. If any opponent has more Favor than you, gain 1 Time.

Name: Freedom Isn't Free Refills
rules_text: Gain 2 Time. Each opponent gains Food Coma. During judging if you present an Extra gain +1 Favor.

Name: Mandatory Lunch Strike
rules_text: Each opponent gains Strike. You may Peel a starter card.

Name: You Call That Sushi?
rules_text: Each opponent Peels the top card of their deck. For each Status Peeled this way, draw 1.

Name: Nonna Says No
rules_text: Cancel one Taste reduction or opponent modifier on one of your dishes. That opponent gains Shame.

Name: Pineapple Tribunal
rules_text: Each opponent who presented or modified a Tomato or Cheese dish this turn gains Shame. If any of those dishes is American, its owner also gains a Distraction.

Name: Pantry Raid
rules_text: Draw 3 then discard 2. If you discarded a Status, gain 1 Time.

Name: Mise En Place
rules_text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck. Put 2 into your hand and discard the rest.

Name: Doomscroll The Menu
rules_text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put 1 into your hand and discard the rest. Gain a Distraction.

Name: Chef's Kiss
rules_text: Draw 2. Choose a Dish in your hand; it gets +1 Taste this turn.

Name: Super Bowl Commercial Break
rules_text: Draw 2. Each opponent may draw 1; each who does gains Food Coma.

Name: Bento Box Planning
rules_text: Draw 1. Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put them back in any order. You may discard any Statuses among them.

Name: Secret Family Recipe
rules_text: Put a Dish from your discard pile into your hand. Draw 1. If it is Tomato or Cheese, gain 1 Time.

Name: Midnight Snack
rules_text: Play a card from your Fridge. If it is a Dish, it gets +2 Taste this turn. Draw 1.

Name: Fridge Raid
rules_text: Look at an opponent's Fridge. You may discard that card. If you do, that opponent gains Food Coma.

Name: 5 Stars
rules_text: During judging if one of your dishes has strictly more Taste than every opponent's dish gain +2 Favor.

Name: Bottomless Refills
rules_text: During judging if you present an Extra gain +2 Favor.

Name: Conveyor Belt
rules_text: At the start of your turn look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order. If any is a Status, you may Peel 1 of them.

Name: Nonna's Table
rules_text: The first time each turn you present 4 or more dishes gain +2 Favor. If the Judge does not favor you, gain +3 Favor instead.

Name: Steakhouse
rules_text: Your first Meat dish each turn gets +1 Taste. During judging if you present at least 2 Meat dishes gain +2 Favor.

Name: Seafood Counter
rules_text: During judging if you present a Seafood dish gain +1 Favor and you may Peel 1.

Name: Cheese Wheel
rules_text: Your Cheese dishes get +1 Taste.

Name: Fry Station
rules_text: During judging if you present a Fried dish gain +2 Favor.

Name: Red Sauce Empire
rules_text: Your Tomato dishes get +1 Taste and cost 1 less to learn.

Name: Rice Cooker
rules_text: Rice dishes cost 1 less to learn. The first Rice dish you learn each turn goes on top of your deck even if it is not your first learned card.

Name: Burger Diplomacy
rules_text: When you learn this, each opponent gains a Burger from the market deck or supply. Your Burgers get +2 Taste. Opponents' Burgers count as Statuses for your effects.

Name: Bureaucratic Cheese Inspection
rules_text: Whenever an opponent presents a dish with 5 or more Taste, they gain a Yelp Review. Your tagless dishes cost 1 more Time to learn.

Name: Conveyor Belt Shogunate
rules_text: At the start of your turn each player Peels the top card of their deck. If you Peel a Dish this way, you may present it this turn.

Name: Nonna's Witness Protection
rules_text: The first time each turn an opponent gives you a Status, give that opponent Shame. Whenever an opponent gains Shame, gain 1 Favor.

Name: Influencer Kitchen
rules_text: Whenever you give a Status to an opponent, gain 1 Favor. At the start of your Fridge step, if you gave no Status this turn, gain a Distraction.

Name: Review Bomb Campaign
rules_text: Whenever you add a Status to an opponent's deck, put 1 token here. If there are 7 or more tokens here at judging, you win the game.

Name: Meal Prep Subscription
rules_text: The first time each turn you draw 2 or more cards from one effect, gain 1 Time. At the start of your Fridge step, if you have no cards in hand, draw 1.

Name: Algorithmic Menu
rules_text: At the start of your turn look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may discard 1. If you discard a Status this way, gain 1 Favor.

Name: Meal Prep Containers
rules_text: At the start of your turn, if your Fridge is full, gain 1 Time. The first Dish you play from your Fridge each turn gets +1 Taste.

Name: FACTION - Appropriate
rules_text: Whenever an opponent presents only dishes from one faction, after scoring steal their lowest-Taste presented dish and add it to your discard pile.

Name: FACTION - Legislation
rules_text: During judging, if your highest-Taste dish has strictly more Taste than each opponent's highest-Taste dish, gain 2 Favor and each opponent loses 1 Favor.

Name: FACTION - Less Is More
rules_text: Whenever an opponent draws 3 or more cards from one effect, that opponent Scorches 1.

Name: FACTION - Without Cream!
rules_text: At the start of your turn, if an opponent gained more Favor than you on their last turn, gain Favor equal to the difference, up to 3.

Name: Foreigner Mistrust
rules_text: At the start of your turn, each opponent gains a Judgment.

Name: Wage Inequalities
rules_text: Whenever you present a dish with 5 or more Taste, each opponent gains Strike.

Name: Distraction
rules_text: No effect. It is still annoying.

Name: Food Coma
rules_text: While this is in your hand, your first card learned each turn costs 1 more Time.

Name: Yelp Review
rules_text: During judging your highest-Taste dish gets -1 Taste. Then Peel Yelp Review.

Name: Health Inspection
rules_text: During judging if you present 3 or more dishes, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Health Inspection.

Name: Strike
rules_text: The first Technique you play each turn costs 1 more Time. Then Peel Strike.

Name: Shame
rules_text: During judging if you present dishes from 2 or more factions, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Shame.

Name: Judgment
rules_text: When drawn, reveal the top card of your deck. Peel it unless it is Japanese. Then Peel Judgment.

Name: Mangia Mangia!
rules_text: When drawn, discard all Dish cards from your hand. Then Peel Mangia Mangia!.

Name: On Strike
rules_text: When drawn, your Cook step ends. Then Peel On Strike.

Name: We Heard You Have Oil
rules_text: When drawn, discard the highest-cost card from your hand. Then Peel We Heard You Have Oil.
